pob.text: Paul[a], a prisoner of Messiah Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon our beloved fellow worker[b],

spob.text: From Paul, a prisoner of Messiah Jesus,[a][b] and from Timothy, our brother. To Philemon, our beloved fellow worker:

public_domain_references.web: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,
public_domain_references.asv: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon our beloved and fellow-worker,
public_domain_references.kjv: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy [our] brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,

pob.text: and to Apphia our sister[a], and to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church in your house:

spob.text: and to Apphia, a sister in the faith,[a] to Archippus, our fellow soldier, and to the church that meets in your house:

public_domain_references.kjv: And to [our] beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:

pob.text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus the Messiah[a].

public_domain_references.asv: I thank my God always, making mention of thee in my prayers,
public_domain_references.kjv: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,

pob.text: because I hear of your love and faith that you have toward the Lord Jesus and for all the saints[c][b][a],

public_domain_references.asv: hearing of thy love, and of the faith which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all the saints;
public_domain_references.kjv: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;

pob.text: so that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing that is in us for the Messiah[a][b][c][d][e].

spob.text: so that your sharing in the faith may become effective through knowing every good thing among us that is for the Messiah.[a][b]

public_domain_references.kjv: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.

pob.text: For I had much joy and encouragement because of your love[a], because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.

spob.text: Your love has given me great joy and encouragement, brother, because you have refreshed the hearts[a] of the saints.[b]

public_domain_references.kjv: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.

pob.text: Therefore[a], though I have much boldness in Messiah to command you to do what is proper[b],

pob.text: I appeal to you concerning my child[a], Onesimus, whom I fathered in my chains[b],

pob.text: who once was useless to you[a], but now is useful both to you and to me,

public_domain_references.bsb: Formerly he was useless to you, but now he has become useful both to you and to me.
public_domain_references.web: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.
public_domain_references.asv: who once was unprofitable to thee, but now is profitable to thee and to me:

pob.text: I am sending him back to you—him[a], that is[b], my very heart.

public_domain_references.asv: whom I have sent back to thee in his own person, that is, my very heart:

pob.text: I wanted to keep him with me[a], so that on your behalf he might serve me in the chains of the gospel,

public_domain_references.asv: whom I would fain have kept with me, that in thy behalf he might minister unto me in the bonds of the gospel:
public_domain_references.kjv: Whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:

pob.text: But without your consent I wanted to do nothing[a], so that your good deed might not be as if by compulsion[c][b], but voluntary.

spob.text: But I did not want to do anything without your consent. That way, your good deed would come from your own free choice, not as if you had been forced.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: But I did not want to do anything without your consent, so that your goodness will not be out of compulsion, but by your own free will.
public_domain_references.web: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.
public_domain_references.asv: but without thy mind I would do nothing; that thy goodness should not be as of necessity, but of free will.
public_domain_references.kjv: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.

pob.text: For perhaps he was separated from you for a time so that you might have him back forever,[a]

spob.text: Perhaps he was separated from you for a while so that you might have him back forever.[a]

public_domain_references.kjv: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;

pob.text: no longer as a slave[a], but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much more to you[b], both in the flesh and in the Lord.

spob.text: No longer as a slave, but as more than a slave—a beloved brother, especially to me. He is even more so to you, both in your human relationship[a] and in the Lord.

public_domain_references.bsb: no longer as a slave, but better than a slave, as a beloved brother. He is especially beloved to me, but even more so to you, both in person and in the Lord.
public_domain_references.web: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
public_domain_references.asv: no longer as a servant, but more than a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much rather to thee, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
public_domain_references.kjv: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?

pob.text: So if you consider me a partner[a], receive him as you would me.

public_domain_references.kjv: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.

pob.text: But if he has wronged you in any way or owes you anything[a], charge this to me.

pob.text: I[a], Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it—not to mention to you that you owe me even your very self.

spob.text: I, Paul, am writing this with my own hand. I will pay it back—not to mention that you owe me even your very self.

public_domain_references.bsb: I, Paul, write this with my own hand. I will repay it—not to mention that you owe me your very self.

pob.text: Yes[a], brother, let me have benefit from you in the Lord[c][b]; refresh my heart in Messiah.
